title: Roomio auditorium file
description: Seat positions for one room. Coordinates are in any consistent unit; the app sizes the map from seat spacing.

schemaVersion.description: Omit only for hand-written files; version 1 is assumed.

name.description: Venue or room name shown in the app.

units.description: Unit of x/y/z. Informational (shown next to coordinates).

yAxis.description: "down" = screen/SVG style (y grows downward); "up" = CAD style (y grows upward).

id.description: Unique seat label, e.g. "A-12-4". Readings are stored against it.

z.description: Height (optional), e.g. for balconies or raked seating.

row.description: Row number or letter. Used for labels and walk-through order.

rotation.description: Degrees; 0 = seat faces up the screen. Default: face the stage.

stage.description: Centre front of the stage. Seats face it; section labels sit on the far side.

foh.description: Suggested FOH mix position (can be moved in the app).

image.description: Floor plan as a data URI, max 25 MB.

background.description: Optional floor-plan drawing placed under the seats, in seat coordinates (x,y = top-left for yAxis down; bottom-left for yAxis up).
